messages.author: 32bf4f27a31a68db
messages.subject: Segfault in rstan
parts:
Hi,

Tinkering with a very simple lognormal model in R, using rstan.

The model goes through the sampling steps, claims to be complete (Elapsed time report, etc.), Then gives me a nasty error:

[41] "Error: segfault from C stack overflow"                                                                                                 
[42] "Warning message:"                                                                                                                      
[43] "Lost warning messages"                                                                                                                 
[44] "Error : C stack usage  140730349396812 is too close to the limit"  


NOTE:  R, at this point has not crashed, I get back a responsive prompt.


Any suggestions?
